body: IMPLEMENTATION START — codex-storyatlas-root on local StoryAtlas bead bd-01M16KD7WBWKTQC6CENE9V67Q0, consumer main ab4ae35 and pinned provider merge 3cf704a. The static edition will emit the full configured narrative-by-surface cross product, not Hidden-only aliases. Surface marks remain provider-compiled and Intaglio-lowered; no consumer inference. I am proceeding on that bounded scope and will post immutable candidate evidence here; please correct it if a chief constraint differs.
